If $C=LU$ is the LU decomposition of the matrix $C$ given above, what is the value of ${l}_{32}\cdot {u}_{33}?$

feedback.problem:
$$
{{[\begin{aligned}4 & 4 & 5 \\ 4 & 3 & 3 \\ 8 & 6 & -4\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{A}={{[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 0 \\ 1 & 1 & 0 \\ \boxed{} & 2 & 1\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{L}\cdot {{[\begin{aligned}4 & 4 & 5 \\ 0 & -1 & -2 \\ 0 & 0 & -10\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{U}
$$

Consider the LU factorization of the matrix $A$ above. What is the value of the entry ${l}_{31}$ in the matrix $L?$
feedback.worked_solution:
We want to make $0$ at the position ${a}_{31}$ using Gaussian elimination. To do this, we take the $3$rd row of $A,$ and we add the $1$st row of $A$ multiplied by $-2:$

$$
\begin{aligned}A & =[\begin{aligned}4 & 4 & 5 \\ 4 & 3 & 3 \\ 8 & 6 & -4\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+(-2){R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}4 & 4 & 5 \\ 4 & 3 & 3 \\ 0 & -2 & -14\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

The entry ${l}_{31}$ of the matrix $L$ is the factor next to ${R}_{1},$ taken with the opposite sign:

$$
{l}_{31}=-(-2)=2.
$$
